provenance.method: ESTIMATE ONLY — no physical canary performed. Rotation corrected from graspnet-eef-panda-p8 by a +90 deg roll about the approach axis (see rotation_history); translation still inherited from Panda pending real-robot calibration.
provenance.estimate_basis: max_gripper_width_m set to Robotiq 2F-85 stroke (0.085 m). T_grasp_eef.translation_xyz is still the Panda placeholder along the approach axis and is NOT measured for the 2F-85 on the UR5e TCP; it will be wrong if the UR TCP is not configured at the finger working point.
provenance.rotation_history: Initial rotation was copied verbatim from graspnet-eef-panda-p8 under the incorrect assumption that graspnet->eef rotation is gripper-agnostic. Real-robot session 6af74f15 showed the compiled eef closing axis fell on grasp_Z (gripper-body axis) instead of grasp_Y (jaw axis) — the classic pi/2 'grasps the long edge' symptom. The Robotiq 2F-85 on the UR5e flange closes 90 deg rotated from the Panda gripper. Fixed by R_old @ Rz(90deg): eef-X now maps to -grasp_Y (jaw/closing axis restored), eef-Z stays grasp_X (approach unchanged). +/-90 deg are physically identical for a symmetric two-finger gripper. Rotation-only change; still needs the physical canary below to confirm.
provenance.requires_before_trust: Physical canary: confirm the jaw closes across the object short edge (rotation fix), then verify finger-center P95 <= 5mm and approach-axis P95 <= 3 deg against the actual UR5e TCP definition; measure and replace T_grasp_eef.translation_xyz.
provenance.approach_axis: +X column of the GraspNet rotation is the approach direction; translation origin is grasp translation_xyz (depth-independent).

candidate_status.reason: Estimated profile for Robotiq 2F-85 on UR5e. Not physically validated. Created to unblock the compile_grasp_seed width gate during sim->real bring-up.
candidate_status.not_validated_because: No held-out lift canary on the real robot; T_grasp_eef translation is an unmeasured placeholder.
candidate_status.gates_unchanged: finger-center P95 <= 5mm, axis P95 <= 3 deg, held-out lift >= 95%. Any miss keeps status=candidate.
candidate_status.intended_use: GraspNet/AnyGrasp-frame to Robotiq 2F-85 EEF calibration for the openeta-ur5e real robot only. Do not use for Panda/sim.
